title: Ondo photo closing card
description: A closing band that is almost all photograph: on desktop one 24px-rounded photo card the full content width and about 700px tall, with a soft dark gradient at its foot and a white two-tone heading and pale button in the bottom-left corner; on phones the heading and button sit above a full-bleed photo. The photo eases from slightly zoomed to still as it scrolls in, and the text fades up.
notes: media slot: the photo; a mid-grey surface when empty
the desktop card forces the theme's dark colours (white text on the photo) with the dark class
layout of the text inferred: the original's text was hidden in the capture
name: ondo-cta

props.name: media
props.description: the photo. A mid-grey surface when empty
